# NOWNodes Blockchain Skills Full Context

This repository packages the `nownodes-skill` Codex skill for agents that build and troubleshoot NOWNodes Blockchain API integrations.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/<org>/nownodes-blockchain-skills --skill nownodes-skill
```

## Skill Contract

The agent should:

- Read the relevant references from `skills/nownodes-skill/references/`.
- Use `NOWNODES_API_KEY` from environment variables.
- Default auth to `api-key` header and check chain-specific docs for exceptions.
- Keep read-only calls separate from signing or broadcasting.
- Avoid live API calls unless the user explicitly asks.
- Handle `401`, `403`, `429`, and upstream errors clearly.
- Verify endpoint capabilities against official NOWNodes docs when availability matters.

## Reference Map

- `overview.md`: API classes and when to use them.
- `authentication.md`: API key handling and client setup.
- `endpoint-selection.md`: chain/network/capability routing.
- `request-patterns.md`: RPC, REST, WSS, Blockbook, retries, broadcast safety.
- `errors-and-limits.md`: troubleshooting and rate limits.
- `examples.md`: minimal copyable examples.
- `framework-recipes.md`: ethers, viem, web3.js, Hardhat, Foundry, web3.py, fetch, requests, WebSocket clients.
- `migrations.md`: provider migration guidance.
- `security-playbook.md`: key storage, rotation, leak response, signing boundaries.
- `capability-matrix.md`: curated quick routing layer.
- `testing-and-evals.md`: manual evals and acceptance checks.
